# A first shift should include a pause

The induction review found that volunteers remember the compliance training slides but cannot say when it is acceptable to stop the queue. We will trial supported practice: an experienced person stays beside a newcomer through a real opening shift. Keep the safety requirements, change how we learn them. [[Volunteer handbook]] needs the same information with fewer implied tests of confidence.
